# @amykit/plugin-notify-inbox

Announcements as a file on disk plus a desktop notification.

A plugin for [amy](https://github.com/nicolasmelo1/amy). It provides `inbox` in the `notify-channel` collection.

Use it when announcements should reach you on this machine: each one is written as a file on disk and raised as a desktop notification, so a missed notification still leaves the file. It adds a channel to notify-fanout, so install that too.

## Install

```sh
amy add @amykit/plugin-notify-inbox
```

Then name it in `~/.amy/config.yaml`:

```yaml
workflows:
  your-profile:
    plugins:
      - "@amykit/plugin-notify-inbox"
```

## Configuration

```yaml
plugins:
  "@amykit/plugin-notify-inbox":
    directory: "needs-input"
```

| Setting | Type | Required | Default | What it is |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `directory` | `string` | no | `needs-input` | where the questions are left, relative to the workspace |

Every field is checked at boot against the schema this package declares. A key that is
not one of the above is a refusal naming the plugin and the key, not a setting that
silently never applied.
